decks.notes: The deck focuses on using the combo between Nomads en-Kor and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to draw tons of cards and generate value through various interactions. It also includes a control element with counter spells like Force of Will and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. The deck aims to set up its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with card advantage and strong board presence. It also utilizes cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Ponder for consistency and digging through the deck.

This deck focuses on utilizing low cost aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, and combining them with disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. The mana base is streamlined to maximize consistency and speed, with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder included for card selection. The goal is to quickly disrupt and overpower the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

This Dragon Stompy deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful red spells, with a heavy emphasis on disrupting opponents' mana bases using Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon. It also utilizes aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf to apply pressure and close out games quickly. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient threats and disrupt their game plan with hate cards that punish greedy mana bases. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to control the game and secure victories through sheer power and speed.

The main goal of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, and then bring them back into play with cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate. This allows the player to cheat out big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game, overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures. The deck also includes counter spells like Force of Will and removal spells like Thoughtseize to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck relies on quickly cycling through the deck and utilizing graveyard recursion to win the game in one explosive turn. With a focus on generating mana and casting spells for free, the deck aims to put all of its spells into the graveyard, then use a combo involving cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to win the game with Thassa's Oracle or other win conditions. The deck also includes disruption and protection elements to ensure its combo goes off smoothly and uncontested.

The main focus of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Eldrazi Temple and Ancient Tomb, allowing for powerful Eldrazi creatures to be played ahead of schedule. Chalice of the Void helps control the opponent's spells, while Thought-Knot Seer disrupts their hand. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive Eldrazi creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and It That Heralds the End, supported by cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Kozilek's Command for additional value. The deck's mana base is also designed to support the Eldrazi strategy efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana in order to cheat big creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn into play using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The deck also includes cards like Omniscience to allow for playing spells for free and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to help protect the combo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and control spells while utilizing various ways to cheat them into play.

This deck focuses on quickly generating mana with rituals and Lion's Eye Diamond to cast a high-impact spell like Ad Nauseam or Tendrils of Agony to win the game in a single turn. The deck is filled with cheap cantrips and hand disruption spells to help sculpt the perfect hand for the combo turn. Burning Wish acts as a versatile toolbox card to find the missing piece needed to win. The deck is able to win as early as turn 1 or 2, making it a powerful and explosive combo deck in the Legacy format.

The deck relies on using Cephalid Illusionist in combination with Nomads en-Kor to mill the library quickly, enabling Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return to win the game instantly. It includes various disruption cards like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo. The deck also has utility lands like Urza's Saga and Cavern of Souls to assist in achieving its game plan. It is a high-risk, high-reward deck that requires precise timing and careful sequencing to execute the combo successfully and win the game in a swift and efficient manner.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly generate mana, disrupt opponents with discard spells, and eventually win the game with a powerful storm combo using cards like Tendrils of Agony and Lion's Eye Diamond. The deck utilizes cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to ramp up mana quickly, while also using Entomb to fill the graveyard for potential combo pieces like Echo of Eons. The inclusion of cards like Agadeem's Awakening and Urza's Saga helps to provide additional versatility and flexibility in executing the storm combo efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Nadu, Winged Wisdom alongside Nomads en-Kor to combo off and draw cards quickly. The deck also includes several control elements such as Force of Will, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support the combo while also providing access to various colors of mana for the deck's spells. Overall, the deck aims to win through a quick combo finish while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping into powerful creatures like Emrakul and Griselbrand by cheating them into play with cards like Show and Tell and Eureka. Using Atraxa and Omniscience, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game while also having protection with Force of Will and Flusterstorm. The inclusion of Brainstorm and Ponder helps to dig for combo pieces quickly, while cards like Lotus Petal and Elvish Spirit Guide provide additional mana acceleration. The deck aims to win the game in just a few turns by combining powerful creatures and spells for a devastating combo.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then bringing them back into play using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By using cards like Unmask and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with large, intimidating creatures. The deck also includes cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to accelerate its game plan and allow for explosive turns.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping into powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupting the opponent with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. It also utilizes land destruction with Wasteland and Glaring Fleshraker to further impede the opponent's gameplan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large threats while controlling the board and preventing the opponent from developing their own strategy effectively. Ultimately, the deck's goal is to apply pressure early and capitalize on the disruptive elements of the Eldrazi creatures to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt opponents' mana bases with cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon while ramping into powerful threats like The One Ring and Pyrogoyf. By utilizing fast mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Chrome Mox, the deck can deploy its game plan quickly and overwhelm opponents with its aggressive game plan. The inclusion of powerful burn spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption also allows the deck to close out games quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on using lands as a control mechanism, utilizing cards like Wasteland, Maze of Ith, and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also aims to create powerful land combinations such as Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to generate threats. The deck includes cards like Crop Rotation and Exploration to find and utilize lands effectively. Additionally, it includes disruption and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to handle threats from opposing decks. The overall strategy is to control the game through strategic land usage and disruption.
